name: Sustainable Water and Sewerage Systems
description:
Characteristics of water; Conventional and emerging pollutants; Source, pathway and transformation of pollutants; toxicity; exposure routes; dose response curve; human health risk assessment; Unit operations and processes; Water treatment scheme: Physico-chemical (sedimentation, coagulation-flocculation, filtration, disinfection), Wastewater treatment scheme: Primary, secondary and tertiary treatment; biological wastewater treatment; Advanced treatment (adsorption,
advanced oxidation and membrane processes); Emerging technologies; Sludge treatment, disposal and resource recovery; zero liquid discharge scheme
